name: The Legend of Stalvan
label: Quest
description: Marshal Haggard sends you back to Darkshire with a page he cannot read. Tavernkeep Smitts may know the hand that wrote it.

clips.title: The story
paras: Marshal Haggard sends you back to Darkshire with a page he cannot read. Tavernkeep Smitts may know the hand that wrote it.

Marshal Haggard cannot read the faded writing on the torn journal page you recovered from his chest in Elwynn Forest. His eyesight is failing. The retired commander remembers serving with the Stormwind Guard and spending evenings at the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire. The trail leads back across the river, so he sends you to Tavernkeep Smitts. Years behind the bar have made Smitts a keeper of local history and rumors.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I know of someone who might be able to assist you. Back when I was leading the Stormwind Guard, we used to get drinks at the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire. The Innkeeper there, Smitts, was quite an expert on the local lore. Show him this page and see what he has to say about it.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Marshal Haggard sent you? Why didn't you say so?
Ah, good ol' Haggard. Poor chap is going to be completely blind before long. Anyway, let me see what you've got there.

clips.title: Completion
paras: By the Light! You bet I recognize that handwriting.
